get.description: Active tenant membership required. Returns non-disconnected connections with status (active, paused, auth_expired) for settings and Inbox banners.

post.description: Tenant owner only. Pages must come from the owner's own unexpired OAuth session. A Page connected to another workspace returns 409 (1 Page = 1 tenant); a Page already connected here is re-authorized.

patch.description: Tenant owner only. Pause/disconnect cancel pending outbound intents; disconnect wipes the stored Page credential and unsubscribes webhooks. Repeating an action in effect re-syncs the connector.
patch.summary: Pause, resume or disconnect a Facebook Page

post.description: Tenant owner only. Returns the Meta OAuth dialog URL with a single-use state valid for 10 minutes. redirect_uri must be the web app /channels/facebook/callback on an allowed origin.

get.description: Active tenant membership required. Returns non-disconnected connections with status (active, paused, auth_expired) for settings and Inbox banners. Bot Tokens are never included.

post.description: Tenant owner only. Verifies the @BotFather Bot Token with getMe through the connector, which stores it encrypted and registers the webhook; the token is never returned. A bot connected to another workspace returns 409 (1 Bot = 1 tenant); a bot already connected here is re-activated with the new token.

patch.description: Tenant owner only. Pause/disconnect cancel pending outbound intents and delete the webhook; disconnect also wipes the stored Bot Token and webhook secret. rotate_token requires bot_token for the same bot (a different bot returns 409) and re-activates the connection. Repeating pause/resume/disconnect in effect re-syncs the connector.
patch.summary: Pause, resume, disconnect or rotate the token of a Telegram bot

get.description: Tenant owner only. Current members with their grants; the owner row always lists all four permissions.
Active tenant membership required. For showing or hiding actions only; every command is authorized again.

post.description: Tenant owner only; the target must be a current, non-owner member. expected_version is the member's permission version (0 before any grant); a stale value conflicts. Granting a held permission changes nothing.
post.summary: Grant one script permission to a member

post.description: Tenant owner only. Takes effect on the member's next action. expected_version is the member's permission version; a stale value conflicts.
post.summary: Revoke one script permission from a member

get.description: Active tenant membership required; members without script permissions can still read. Newest change first.

post.description: Requires script.create (owner implicitly). The UUID Idempotency-Key becomes the script ID; replaying the same payload returns the original script and a changed payload conflicts.
post.summary: Create an inactive script with draft v1

get.description: Active tenant membership required. Versions are newest first (at most 100); published versions never change.
get.summary: Get a script with its version history

post.description: Requires script.activate. Points the script at the selected version (the draft or an earlier published version); a draft is frozen on activation.
Requires script.archive. Archived is terminal; the script and all versions are kept, never deleted.
Requires script.activate. The script becomes inactive; its versions stay in history.

put.description: Requires script.edit. Rewrites the open draft, or opens draft vN+1 when every version is published (editing an active script never changes its active content). Stale expected_version or an archived script conflicts.

parameters.description: Name, draft content and expected script version
parameters.name: request

get.description: Active tenant membership required. configured=false means the owner never chose a mode: new conversations wait for staff and reply_mode reads as suggest.
get.summary: Read the tenant's bot reply mode

put.description: Tenant owner only. suggest: the bot proposes and a sale sends; auto_send: the bot sends eligible replies itself while a conversation is under bot handling. The first save also enables bot handling for new conversations. expected_version is the version last read (0 before the first save); a stale version is 409. Existing proposals are never sent by a mode change.
put.summary: Change the tenant's bot reply mode

post.summary: Claim an unassigned conversation or take control of own assignment

post.description: Current assignee or tenant owner required for staffed conversations. Handoff of a bot conversation requires active tenant membership. No AI or live channel dispatch is performed.
post.summary: Move a conversation to the durable staff queue with a reason

post.description: Assigned sale under sales control only; the conversation's Page/bot connection must be active. Records the message as sending with a single-attempt delivery intent; the connector reports sent, failed (window_24h, auth_expired, rate_limit, invalid_recipient, bot_blocked, chat_not_found, transport) or unknown. Never retried automatically. Retrying the same client_message_id returns the original message.
post.summary: Send a real channel reply (Facebook or Telegram) as the assigned sale

post.description: Nothing is sent. The assigned sale, the tenant owner, or any member while the conversation is unassigned may discard; stale proposals can be discarded. 409 when the proposal is no longer pending.

Omit text to send the proposal unchanged. Only the assigned sale may send on a staff-handled conversation; on a bot-handled conversation the sender claims it atomically with the send. A stale proposal (conversation control changed after it was created) or one that is no longer pending is 409. Real channels get a single-attempt delivery intent; simulator conversations a simulated message. Retrying the same client_message_id returns the original message.
post.summary: Send a bot reply proposal as-is or edited

post.description: Answers the turn's newest customer message and replaces its live proposal. Any member on a bot-handled conversation, the assigned sale on a staff-handled one. A requested proposal is never sent automatically and never changes control. Returns the routing job; poll the conversation for the result.
post.summary: Ask the bot for a new proposal at the current conversation control

post.description: Only the assigned sale under staff control can resolve. Restarts the 24-hour inactivity window and keeps staff control; nothing returns to the bot. 409 when the turn changed, is closed or does not need a person.
post.summary: Mark a conversation's needs-human flag resolved

post.description: Current assignee or tenant owner required for staffed conversations. Handoff of a bot conversation requires active tenant membership. No AI or live channel dispatch is performed.
post.summary: Explicitly return a conversation to bot control without replaying messages

post.description: Simulator only; no real provider sending. Requires current active tenant membership.
post.summary: Save a simulated reply as the current assigned sale

proposals.description: Proposals are the latest turn's live bot reply proposals (at most one routing or pending proposal).

waiting_staff_count.description: WaitingStaffCount is the number of open conversations waiting for staff (unassigned, staff control).

connection_id.description: ConnectionID names the bound channel connection of a real conversation; empty for simulator threads.

closed_at.description: ClosedAt is set on a closed turn (24-hour inactivity expiry); a new customer message opens a new turn.

needs_human_reason.description: NeedsHumanReason is the handoff reason code behind needs_human; omitted when none was given.

requested_by.description: RequestedBy is set when a person asked for this proposal (regenerate).

auto_confirm.description: Legacy callers must not silently bypass explicit confirmation.

valid.description: Valid is true if Time is not NULL
